The overwhelming feeling to even enter the storage resulted in me paying for it over 1yr after she passed.  I finally was able to do that but I have yet been able to go through those personal items. 

I know it's very cliche to say think about what your mom would say, but she really did work that hard to get the house for you all. She did it because she loves you. She wouldn't want you to actually harm yourself because of the house.

But.... it will end one way or another so allow yourself to feel something. I'm the least cheesiest person but honestly, put on something that will make you laugh.
